Formula Each iteration rebuilds a uniform grid index from current positions (cell offsets, vertex ids, per-cell mean position). For vertex v: F = -GRAVITY*p + REPULSION*(exact all-pairs terms over vertices in cells within NEAR_CELL_RADIUS (Chebyshev) of v's cell, plus for every other occupied cell whose squared diagonal < THETA^2 * |p-center|^2, one monopole: mass*(p-center)/max(|p-center|^2, MINIMUM_DISTANCE_SQUARED)) + ATTRACTION*sum over forward CSR neighbors (q-p), plus reverse CSR neighbors when a reverse topology is supplied (incident edges). Cells that are neither near nor accepted are visited vertex by vertex, so THETA=0 is exact. Velocity = (velocity + F*TIME_STEP)*DAMPING capped to MAX_VELOCITY, then position += velocity*TIME_STEP. Out-of-bounds positions or index overflow freeze positions and clear velocities.
